name: margin
description: margin: a Firefox sidebar that sits in the margin of a lecture. Jot as you go; the TA answers and checks under your notes from a precomputed concept brain.

scripts.dev: npx wrangler pages dev site --kv TA_KV --binding TA_TOKEN=devtoken --binding TA_MOCK=1 --port 8789
scripts.dev:live: npx wrangler pages dev site --kv TA_KV --binding TA_TOKEN=devtoken --port 8789
scripts.ext: cd extension && zip -qr ../margin-extension.zip . -x '.*' && echo wrote margin-extension.zip
scripts.deploy: ./check.sh && npx wrangler pages deploy site --project-name margin
